name: PROHIBEAST
detailed_description:
Prohibeast – Stealth Tactics at the Heart of Prohibition

In Prohibeast, a real-time tactical infiltration game, dive into a 1930s Chicago plagued by corruption and the smuggling of meat.

As meat consumption is banned, Al Capone expands his criminal empire through a ruthless black market. In the face of widespread corruption, Eliot Ness and his team of Untouchables are ready to strike from the shadows to take down the underworld from within.

Infiltration & Strategy: Define Your Own Style

Every mission will test your strategic thinking and stealth skills.

◆ Plan Your Operations – Choose your approach: silent infiltration, discreet neutralization, or clever diversion.
◆ Use the Environment – Hideouts, alternate paths, distractions… Each mission offers multiple solutions.
◆ Outsmart the Enemies’ Sharp Senses – Keen vision, acute hearing, heightened smell… Discover a new way to play where infiltration is no longer just about hiding!

Lead the Untouchables

As the leader of the Untouchables, take control of Eliot Ness and his team, a group of specialists with complementary skills—each playing a crucial role in your infiltration missions:

◆ Eliot Ness – A bold and adaptable leader, capable of handling any situation to complete even the most dangerous missions.
◆ Malone B. Clonan – A tough and loyal right-hand man, favoring a more direct and forceful approach.
◆ Frank E. Eager – A methodical and discreet sniper, eliminating targets with deadly precision.

Additional specialists will join your team to refine your strategies.
Learn to leverage their strengths and weaknesses to craft unique strategies and catch the underworld off guard.

Infiltrate Iconic Locations

Each mission takes you deep into Chicago’s most crime-ridden and corrupt hotspots.
Observe, plan, and adapt your approach to achieve your objectives without leaving a trace.

From The Loop, Chicago’s iconic district and center of corrupt power, to the mayor’s residence, where criminal alliances are forged, and the foggy docks of Lake Michigan, a key smuggling hub—each location is filled with dangers and opportunities, requiring tailored approaches to survive.

But other criminal strongholds await, where even the slightest mistake could be fatal.
Only the most strategic players will infiltrate undetected.

Will you be able to operate in the shadows and bring down Al Capone’s criminal empire?

short_description: Immerse yourself in a 1930s Chicago plagued by corruption and illegal meat trafficking. In this stealth-tactics game, control Eliot Ness and his team. Exploit the environment, deceive your enemies and strike the mafia from the shadows to dismantle Al Capone's criminal empire.
